body:
Adds `research/slew-twin`: a twin without an actuator rate limit is exact only for `x0 <= r/k` (exact, scale-invariant). Beyond that the real loop overshoots and settles in O(amplitude) steps. The `2n(2n-1)` overshoot threshold for `k=1/n` is empirical and marked as such.

Includes tests (7), experiment script and results, white paper, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok (166 projects).
